name: claude-md-enhancer
tagline_zh: 新项目还在裸奔？老 CLAUDE.md 像坨乱麻？它能按技术栈与模块化架构，自动锻造出 AI 协作标准。
tagline_en: New project with no CLAUDE.md? Existing one a mess? It forges AI-ready standards per stack & modular.
desc_en: Analyzes, generates, and enhances CLAUDE.md files for any project type using best practices, modular architecture support, and tech stack customization. Use when setting up new projects, improving existing CLAUDE.md files, or establishing AI-assisted development standards.
why_zh: 同类只会套模板，它却先解析项目结构再生成，模块化支持到每个目录，注释风格随技术栈自动切换。
why_en: Unlike template-only tools, it parses your project structure first, then generates modular-aware CLAUDE.md with stack-specific.
